GeneDef.label: graft rejection
GeneDef.description: Carriers' bodies reject anything put in by surgery: no prosthetic, bionic, implant or transplant takes, and a lost part stays lost.

GeneDef.label: psychosis resistance
GeneDef.description: Carriers are resistant to tenebral psychosis. It still grows in them, but far slower.

GeneDef.label: umbral transformation
GeneDef.description: Carriers change, one kill at a time. Killing a person may start a transformation that, after a few weak days, grows an Umbral part: organs and limbs first, then an exoskeleton and exoskull, and last a utility pod.

XenotypeDef.label: umbral
XenotypeDef.description: What is left of a tenebral host once the crystal has taken half the body and the Umbral Transformation Pod has finished the rest. Umbrals take no surgery and slowly rebuild themselves through killing.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: The end of the tenebral path.
